name: Methcathinone
summary: Methcathinone is a empathogen substance belonging to the Cathinone, Substituted cathinones chemical class.

pharmacology.text: Methcathinone is a norepinephrine–dopamine releasing agent (NDRA). Methcathinone has very strong affinities for the dopamine transporter (DAT) and the norepinephrine transporter (NET). Its affinity for the serotonin transporter (SERT) is less than that of methamphetamine.

uses.text: It is used as a recreational drug due to its stimulant and euphoric effects and is considered to be addictive, with both physical and psychological withdrawal occurring if its use is discontinued after prolonged or high-dosage administration. It is usually snorted, but can be smoked, injected, or taken orally.

sideEffects.text: Side effects of methcathinone include sympathomimetic effects like increased heart rate and blood pressure. Users can easily forget to consume fluids leading to increased thirst and dehydration. Methcathinone can be highly psychologically addictive, and can produce a methamphetamine-like withdrawal.

summaryZh: 甲卡西酮又稱α-甲氨基苯丙酮，是是卡西酮類的合成藥，屬於苯丙胺類β酮基的精神興奮劑，因具有中樞神經興奮作用而被濫用。甲卡西酮與甲基苯丙胺結構相似，結構簡式為 C₆H₅COCHNHCH₃，列為中國Ⅰ類精神管制藥物、台灣第三級毒品。因類似浴鹽，故俗稱「浴鹽」。
